package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/outbox"
	velav1 "github.com/vivym/vela/proto/gen/vela/v1"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

type publishResult struct {
	Subject      string `json:"subject"`
	MessageID    string `json:"message_id"`
	Payload      []byte `json:"payload"`
	KnownPayload bool   `json:"known_payload"`
	UnknownBytes int    `json:"unknown_bytes"`
}

type captureBroker struct {
	result publishResult
}

func (b *captureBroker) Publish(
	_ context.Context,
	subject string,
	messageID string,
	payload []byte,
) (outbox.Receipt, error) {
	var envelope velav1.EventEnvelope
	if err := proto.Unmarshal(payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		return outbox.Receipt{}, fmt.Errorf("decode event with N-1 descriptor: %w", err)
	}
	b.result = publishResult{
		Subject:      subject,
		MessageID:    messageID,
		Payload:      append([]byte(nil), payload...),
		KnownPayload: envelope.GetPayload() != nil,
		UnknownBytes: len(envelope.ProtoReflect().GetUnknown()),
	}
	return outbox.Receipt{Stream: "N_MINUS_ONE_PROBE", Sequence: 1}, nil
}

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_INTERNAL_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	broker := &captureBroker{}
	publisher, err := outbox.NewPublisher(pool, broker, outbox.Config{
		InstanceID: "n-minus-one-outbox-probe",
		BatchSize:  1,
		ClaimTTL:   30 * time.Second,
		RetryDelay: 0,
	})
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	published, err := publisher.PublishBatch(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if published != 1 {
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("published %d events, want 1", published))
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(broker.result); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
